items.title_zh: 韩国首次利用紧急灾难通知“0 级短信”打击 AI 辅助作弊行为，成功在高考中抓获 54 名违规考生
items.title_en: South Korea uses "Level 0" emergency disaster alerts for the first time in its college entrance exam to curb AI-assisted cheating, catching 54 violators
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据《韩国先驱报》报道，韩国教育部在 2027 学年度大学修学能力考试（韩国高考）中，首次利用紧急灾难通知“0 级短信”协助打击考试作弊行为，以此成功抓获 54 名违规考生。连同其他检查手段在内，累计有 111 名考生被查出携带违禁设备。 根据韩国媒体报道，考试当天上午 8 时 30 分，也就是正式开考前 10 分钟，第一轮紧急警报响起，共有 31 名考生因携带未经允许的电子设备被查出，相关考生成绩随即被判无效。当天下午 2 时 21 分和 2 时 57 分，第二轮和第三轮警报又分别发现了违规考生，使通过警报系统查出的违规人数达到 54 人。 后续，警方和考务人员又通过金属探测器、Wi-Fi 信号检测以及人工搜查等手段，发现 52 名违规考生，还有 5 人被当场发现正在使用违禁设备， 累计共有 111 名考生被抓 。 与此同时，韩国近期还发生了一起与 AI 辅助作弊争议相关的事件。一名曾在韩国法学院入学考试中取得满分的考生李镇宇（Lee Jin-woo），于高考当天被发现死于一家汽车旅馆。 今年 7 月，李镇宇在韩国法学教育资格考试（LEET）中取得满分，据报道，他是“该考试历史上首位取得这一成绩的考生”。几个月后，他还出版了一本介绍个人学习方法的书籍，分享自己在生活习惯、锻炼、饮食以及减少智能手机使用等方面的调整经验。然而在税务师考试作弊事件曝光后，网络上开始有人质疑李镇宇此前取得的 LEET 满分是否涉及 AI 辅助作弊。 原本，李镇宇计划于韩国高考当天接受采访，以证明自己的学术能力，但他最终没有现身。当天，警方正在调查针对他的法律控告，同时也接到其失踪报告。随后，警方于下午 1 时 12 分在一家汽车旅馆内发现其遗体，初步确认死因为心脏骤停。现场还留有一张字条，内容称其“身心俱疲”，但没有提及作弊指控等相关内容。 目前，韩国针对 AI 辅助考试作弊的讨论仍在持续，此次高考大规模启用紧急灾难通知“0 级短信”，也反映出当地考试机构正在加强对微型摄像头、智能手机及其他电子设备的防范。
items.summary_en: According to The Korea Herald, South Korea's Ministry of Education used the "Level 0" emergency disaster alert for the first time during the 2027 academic-year College Scholastic Ability Test (the country's college entrance exam) to help crack down on exam cheating, catching 54 violators. Together with other screening methods, 111 test-takers in total were found carrying prohibited devices. At 8:30 a.m. on exam day, 10 minutes before the test began, the first emergency alert sounded and 31 test-takers were caught with unauthorized electronic devices, and their scores were immediately invalidated; further alerts at 2:21 p.m. and 2:57 p.m. uncovered more violators, bringing the number detected through the alert system to 54. Police and exam staff later found 52 more violators using metal detectors, Wi-Fi signal detection and manual searches, and 5 people were caught using prohibited devices on the spot, for a total of 111. Separately, a test-taker named Lee Jin-woo, who had scored a perfect result in South Korea's Legal Education Eligibility Test (LEET), was found dead in a motel on the day of the exam. In July he achieved a perfect LEET score and was reported to be "the first test-taker in the exam's history to do so," and months later published a book about his study methods. After a cheating incident in the tax accountant exam came to light, some online users questioned whether his LEET score involved AI-assisted cheating. He had been scheduled to give an interview on exam day to prove his academic ability but did not appear; police were investigating a legal complaint against him and also received a missing-person report, and later found his body in a motel at 1:12 p.m., with cardiac arrest preliminarily identified as the cause of death. A note at the scene said he was "exhausted in body and mind" but did not mention the cheating allegations. Discussion in South Korea about AI-assisted exam cheating continues, and the large-scale use of the "Level 0" alert in this exam also reflects local exam authorities' tightening defenses against miniature cameras, smartphones and other electronic devices.
items.why_zh: 推测：若属实，这是国家级高风险考试首次把公共紧急警报系统用于反作弊，可能影响其他国家对电子设备与AI作弊的监管思路；摘要未提供效果评估，需谨慎看待。
items.why_en: Speculative: if accurate, this would be a rare case of a national high-stakes exam using a public emergency alert system for anti-cheating, potentially influencing how other countries police device- and AI-assisted cheating; the summary provides no assessment of effectiveness, so caution is warranted.

items.title_zh: 美参议员痛批苹果、谷歌：放任 AI 脱衣应用“野蛮生长”
items.title_en: US senators criticize Apple and Google for allowing AI "nudify" apps
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据英国《卫报》报道，美国参议员罗恩 · 怀登、埃德 · 马基和本 · 卢汉指出，苹果和谷歌未能有效识别或下架用于生成未经当事人同意的裸照或色情图像的应用。 三人还指出，Meta 仍在从这些所谓的 AI 脱衣应用广告中获利。 当地时间 18 日，三人向苹果、谷歌和 Meta 的 CEO 致函，指出各公司现有的防护措施 不足以阻止 AI 脱衣应用出现在各自的应用商店或平台上 。 研究发现，苹果、谷歌和 Meta 的政策均禁止此类应用，它们却仍然出现在苹果和谷歌应用商店中，或通过 Meta 平台上的广告推广。研究还发现，儿童依然能够轻易接触到这些应用。 来自俄勒冈州的参议员怀登指出，如果这些公司不加强打击那些专门为造成伤害而设计并推广的应用，国会就需要采取行动。“AI 大幅提升了制作和传播未经当事人同意的色情影像的能力，给女性和女孩造成了巨大伤害。大型科技公司没有增加应对这一挑战的投入，反而在削减负责保护用户免受伤害的团队。我希望弄清楚，为什么 Meta、苹果和谷歌会漏掉那些明显违反自身规则的行为。” 谷歌发言人卡尔 · 瑞安在声明中回应称：“Google Play 不允许含有色情内容或允许用户对他人图像进行 AI 脱衣处理的应用上架。我们一直主动采取措施，检测并下架含有有害内容的应用。” Meta 发言人安迪 · 斯通在声明中回应称：“我们禁止传播儿童性虐待材料（CSAM），也禁止推广 AI 脱衣应用，并积极采取措施，防止此类内容出现在我们的平台上。…… 我们已经采取多项措施打击这些行为，包括封禁、对其他广告商采取法律行动、打击协同行动网络，以及 删除 9200 万条色情广告 。我们也在积极探索进一步改进检测能力的方法。” 苹果发言人彼得 · 阿杰米安表示，TTP 的报告并未反映苹果现行的软件及安全功能。苹果新增的保护措施包括加强对青少年的保护，以及在“屏幕使用时间”中扩展家长控制功能，让家庭能够阻止儿童和青少年下载年龄分级超出其年龄范围的应用。 IT之家从报道中获悉，参议员们在信中指出，过去两年， 未经当事人同意而由 AI 生成的裸照数量有所增加 。这一趋势也在多项调查得到印证。联合国儿童基金会在 2026 年初发布的报告显示，11 个国家至少有 120 万名儿童报告称，自己曾遭遇未经本人同意的裸照侵害。 10 月，TTP 研究人员就他们在苹果 App Store 发现的 AI 脱衣应用联系苹果后，苹果对自身政策作出了进一步说明。谷歌此前向《卫报》表示，公司会主动检测并下架含有有害内容的应用。Meta 则推出了新的 AI 工具，专门用于识别和删除含有 CSAM 的广告。 参议员们在信中写道，这些发现表明，苹果和谷歌不仅没有下架助长私密影像侵害的应用，还可能从这些应用的分发过程中获利。
items.summary_en: According to The Guardian, US Senators Ron Wyden, Ed Markey and Ben Luján said Apple and Google have failed to effectively identify or remove apps used to generate non-consensual nude or sexual images, and that Meta is still profiting from ads for so-called AI nudify apps. On the 18th local time, the three sent letters to the CEOs of Apple, Google and Meta, saying the companies' existing safeguards are insufficient to keep AI nudify apps off their app stores or platforms. Research found that all three companies' policies prohibit such apps, yet they still appear in Apple's and Google's app stores or are promoted through ads on Meta's platforms, and that children can still easily access them. Senator Wyden of Oregon said that if the companies do not crack down harder on apps designed and promoted to cause harm, Congress will need to act, adding: "AI has dramatically increased the ability to create and spread non-consensual sexual imagery, causing enormous harm to women and girls. Instead of increasing investment to meet this challenge, Big Tech companies are cutting teams responsible for protecting users from harm. I want to understand why Meta, Apple and Google are missing conduct that clearly violates their own rules." Google spokesperson Karl Ryan said in a statement that "Google Play does not allow apps that contain sexual content or that allow users to AI-undress images of others. We take proactive steps to detect and remove apps with harmful content." Meta spokesperson Andy Stone said: "We prohibit the dissemination of child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and the promotion of AI nudify apps, and we take active measures to prevent such content on our platforms... We have taken multiple steps to combat this, including bans, legal action against other advertisers, action against coordinated networks, and the removal of 92 million sexual ads. We are also actively exploring ways to further improve our detection capabilities." Apple spokesperson Peter Ajemian said TTP's report does not reflect Apple's current software and safety features; Apple's added protections include stronger safeguards for minors and expanded parental controls in Screen Time so families can block children and teens from downloading apps rated above their age. The senators' letter said AI-generated non-consensual nude images have increased over the past two years, a trend corroborated by multiple investigations. A UNICEF report published in early 2026 found that at least 1.2 million children across 11 countries reported being victims of non-consensual nude imagery. In October, after TTP researchers contacted Apple about AI nudify apps they found in the App Store, Apple provided further clarification of its policies. Google previously told The Guardian it proactively detects and removes apps with harmful content, and Meta launched a new AI tool specifically to identify and remove ads containing CSAM. The senators wrote that these findings show Apple and Google have not only failed to remove apps that facilitate intimate-image abuse but may also profit from distributing them.
items.why_zh: 推测：这显示AI生成未经同意的私密影像正成为平台治理与立法压力的焦点，但信中指控与公司回应尚属各执一词，摘要未提供独立核实。
items.why_en: Speculative: this shows AI-generated non-consensual intimate imagery is becoming a focus of platform-governance and legislative pressure, but the letter's allegations and the companies' responses remain competing claims, with no independent verification provided in the summary.

items.title_zh: 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格：随着 AI 需要“一万倍的效率飞跃”，渐进式芯片性能提升无法满足
items.title_en: Former Intel CEO Gelsinger: AI needs a "10,000x efficiency leap," incremental chip gains won't suffice
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据 Wccftech 报道，前英特尔首席执行官帕特 · 基辛格（Pat Gelsinger）表示，随着人工智能需要“ 10,000 倍的效率飞跃 ”，渐进式的芯片增益将无法满足需求，他同时否认了摩尔定律已走向终结。 在 2026 年 COSM 科技峰会上，帕特 · 基辛格出席了一场题为“现实检验：超越芯片（Reality Check: Beyond Chips）”的炉边谈话。 基辛格在谈话中反驳了半导体微缩已触及物理极限的观点， 他认为 AI 需要的不是常规的代际升级，而是计算效率实现激进的 10,000 倍跃升 。他还指出，摩尔定律（Moore’s Law）能否重焕生机，取决于五大核心工程领域（IT之家注：光学、供电、散热、材料和封装）的根本性突破。 峰会结束后，帕特 · 基辛格在 X 上写道：“ 摩尔定律已死？我说现在是唤醒它的时候了 ！”尽管一些行业观察人士可能会认为传统的摩尔定律微缩已经结束，但基辛格坚持认为半导体工程正在进入一个多学科创新的新时代，他表示：“在半导体行业工作 40 多年后，我相信我们最伟大的创新仍在前方！” 自 2025 年 3 月以普通合伙人身份加入风险投资机构 Playground Global 以来，基辛格一直在积极支持针对这些硬件瓶颈的初创企业，其中包括获得美国政府支持的光刻初创企业 xLight（该公司目标突破阿斯麦 ASML 的 13.5 纳米极紫外 EUV 波长壁垒），以及核能产能公司 Alva Energy。 除了光刻与发电领域，基辛格的技术路线图还瞄准了光互连与硅光子技术，旨在用光信号替代传统的铜线来传输数据。 相关阅读： 《 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格称 HBM 是“糟糕的内存” 》 《 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格押注新 AI 内存：Z2RAM 拟绕开 EUV 光刻，4 年内送样 》
items.summary_en: According to Wccftech, former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger said that with AI requiring a "10,000x efficiency leap," incremental chip gains will not be enough, while rejecting the idea that Moore's Law is over. At the 2026 COSM technology summit, Gelsinger took part in a fireside chat titled "Reality Check: Beyond Chips." He pushed back on the view that semiconductor scaling has hit physical limits, arguing that AI needs not routine generational upgrades but a radical 10,000x jump in computing efficiency. He also said whether Moore's Law can be revived depends on fundamental breakthroughs in five core engineering areas: optics, power delivery, thermal management, materials and packaging. After the summit, Gelsinger wrote on X: "Moore's Law is dead? I say it's time to wake it up!" While some industry observers may believe traditional Moore's Law scaling has ended, Gelsinger insists semiconductor engineering is entering a new era of multidisciplinary innovation, saying: "After more than 40 years in the semiconductor industry, I believe our greatest innovations are still ahead of us!" Since joining venture firm Playground Global as a general partner in March 2025, Gelsinger has actively backed startups targeting these hardware bottlenecks, including US-government-backed lithography startup xLight, which aims to break ASML's 13.5-nanometer extreme ultraviolet (EUV) wavelength barrier, and nuclear capacity company Alva Energy. Beyond lithography and power generation, Gelsinger's roadmap also targets optical interconnect and silicon photonics, aiming to replace traditional copper wiring with optical signals for data transmission.
items.why_zh: 推测：这反映前沿AI算力瓶颈正把讨论从单纯制程微缩推向材料、封装、供电与光互连等多学科工程，但属个人判断而非行业共识。
items.why_en: Speculative: this reflects how frontier AI compute bottlenecks are pushing debate beyond pure process scaling toward multidisciplinary engineering in materials, packaging, power and optical interconnect, but it is one person's view rather than an industry consensus.

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据 Wccftech 报道，前英特尔首席执行官帕特 · 基辛格（Pat Gelsinger）表示，随着人工智能需要“ 10,000 倍的效率飞跃 ”，渐进式的芯片增益将无法满足需求，他同时否认了摩尔定律已走向终结。 在 2026 年 COSM 科技峰会上，帕特 · 基辛格出席了一场题为“现实检验：超越芯片（Reality Check: Beyond Chips）”的炉边谈话。 基辛格在谈话中反驳了半导体微缩已触及物理极限的观点， 他认为 AI 需要的不是常规的代际升级，而是计算效率实现激进的 10,000 倍跃升 。他还指出，摩尔定律（Moore’s Law）能否重焕生机，取决于五大核心工程领域（IT之家注：光学、供电、散热、材料和封装）的根本性突破。 峰会结束后，帕特 · 基辛格在 X 上写道：“ 摩尔定律已死？我说现在是唤醒它的时候了 ！”尽管一些行业观察人士可能会认为传统的摩尔定律微缩已经结束，但基辛格坚持认为半导体工程正在进入一个多学科创新的新时代，他表示：“在半导体行业工作 40 多年后，我相信我们最伟大的创新仍在前方！” 自 2025 年 3 月以普通合伙人身份加入风险投资机构 Playground Global 以来，基辛格一直在积极支持针对这些硬件瓶颈的初创企业，其中包括获得美国政府支持的光刻初创企业 xLight（该公司目标突破阿斯麦 ASML 的 13.5 纳米极紫外 EUV 波长壁垒），以及核能产能公司 Alva Energy。 除了光刻与发电领域，基辛格的技术路线图还瞄准了光互连与硅光子技术，旨在用光信号替代传统的铜线来传输数据。 相关阅读： 《 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格称 HBM 是“糟糕的内存” 》 《 前英特尔 CEO 基辛格押注新 AI 内存：Z2RAM 拟绕开 EUV 光刻，4 年内送样 》

items.title_en: "Big Short" Michael Burry on the AI stock selloff: I warned you
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，“大空头”迈克尔 · 伯里在 X 平台发文称：“CoreWeave、Nebius、英伟达，还有半导体股，我都试着提醒过大家。我没让你们做空，但我提供的信息 足以让你们决定卖出股票 。” 当地时间 20 日开盘，英伟达股价下跌约 4%（最高跌幅达 14%），CoreWeave 和 Nebius 的跌幅均在 7% 左右。 据《商业内幕》报道，自 10 月 6 日触及盘中高点以来，英伟达、CoreWeave 和 Nebius 的股价分别下跌约 42%、55% 和 65%。本轮 AI 股回调始于 10 月 7 日，同期纽约证券交易所半导体指数累计下跌约 30%。 11 月 11 日，黄仁勋辞去英伟达 CEO 职务的前一天，伯里在 Substack 发文 呼吁股东卖出英伟达股票 。他预测，随着频频促成交易的黄仁勋离任，英伟达的 增长将放缓，利润率也将收窄 。 11 月 12 日，伯里又将警告范围扩大到 Nebius 和 CoreWeave 等英伟达合作伙伴。此类企业被称为“新型云服务商 / 新云服务商”， 主要通过建设数据中心，向客户出租英伟达芯片及其他 AI 基础设施的使用权 。 伯里指出，英伟达的市场影响力和慷慨扶持让这些企业受益匪浅，但这种局面似乎发生了根本变化。 早在 8 月 12 日，伯里就曾断言：“Nebius 就是繁荣行情见顶的写照。” Nebius 当天的收盘价为 259 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,733 元人民币） ，比 11 月 19 日的收盘价高出 62%。 再往前一周，伯里 8 月 6 日称自己 忍不住想做空 Nebius 和甲骨文 ，认为做空两家公司简直易如反掌。今年，他还做空过英伟达、CoreWeave 及半导体指数。 伯里一年前不再经营对冲基金，转而通过 Substack 分享个人投资观点。此后，他始终对 AI 股票的暴涨持公开怀疑态度。 作为一名逆向投资者，伯里曾是少数 成功预见 2008 年房地产泡沫破裂并从中获利 的人之一。他一直警告，AI 企业对芯片、数据中心等折旧迅速的资产投入过多资金。 伯里还批评 AI 企业采用激进的会计处理手法、开展循环融资交易，并背负着危险规模的债务和表外负债。 此次，伯里再次在 X 平台强调，他对英伟达及其合作伙伴和同行的担忧远不止黄仁勋涉嫌婚外情，以及民主党控制参众两院后可能出现的对 AI 行业不利的政治环境。“如果你还觉得这一切只是婚外情和政治问题，那就说明你 想得还不够深 。”
items.summary_en: "Big Short" investor Michael Burry wrote on X: "CoreWeave, Nebius, Nvidia, and semis — I tried to warn you. I didn't tell you to short, but the information I provided was enough for you to decide to sell." At the open on the 20th local time, Nvidia shares fell about 4% (with a maximum drop of 14%), while CoreWeave and Nebius each fell about 7%. According to Business Insider, since hitting intraday highs on Oct. 6, Nvidia, CoreWeave and Nebius shares are down about 42%, 55% and 65% respectively. The AI stock pullback began on Oct. 7, and the NYSE Semiconductor Index has fallen about 30% over the same period. On Nov. 11, the day before Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia CEO, Burry published a Substack post urging shareholders to sell Nvidia, predicting that growth would slow and margins would narrow after Huang, who frequently brokered deals, departed. On Nov. 12, Burry widened his warning to Nvidia partners such as Nebius and CoreWeave. These companies, called "neoclouds," mainly build data centers and rent out access to Nvidia chips and other AI infrastructure. Burry said Nvidia's market influence and generous support benefited these firms, but that situation appears to have fundamentally changed. As early as Aug. 12, Burry declared: "Nebius is the picture of a boom topping out." Nebius closed that day at $259, 62% above its Nov. 19 close. A week earlier, on Aug. 6, Burry said he could hardly resist shorting Nebius and Oracle, calling shorting both companies easy. This year he also shorted Nvidia, CoreWeave and the semiconductor index. Burry stopped running a hedge fund a year ago and now shares his investment views on Substack; since then he has been openly skeptical of the AI stock surge. A contrarian investor, Burry was among the few who foresaw and profited from the 2008 housing bubble bust. He has warned that AI companies are investing too much in rapidly depreciating assets such as chips and data centers. Burry has also criticized AI companies for aggressive accounting, circular financing deals, and dangerous levels of debt and off-balance-sheet liabilities. On X this time, Burry stressed that his concerns about Nvidia, its partners and peers go far beyond Huang's alleged extramarital affair and the potentially unfavorable political environment for AI if Democrats control both chambers of Congress. "If you still think this is just an affair and politics, you're not thinking deeply enough."

items.why_en: Speculative: Burry's public warnings could amplify market concerns about AI capital spending and accounting quality, but his views are personal bets, and the summary provides no verification of his track record or the data.

items.title_zh: 代码显示三星正为 One UI 9.5 开发 AI 智能天气提醒功能：可根据用户作息与通勤时间推送通知
items.title_en: Code suggests Samsung is developing AI smart weather alerts for One UI 9.5, timed to users' routines and commutes
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，外媒 SammyGuru 在拆解三星最新 One UI 9.5 测试版时，发现三星正在为天气应用测试多项 AI 智能提醒功能，系统能够识别用户的起床时间和通勤行为，在用户起床、上班或下班回家时自动加载最新天气信息。 具体来看，相应功能依赖三星 Personal Data Intelligence（个人数据智能）系统，能够识别用户早晨何时起床、何时开始通勤，当系统检测到用户离开家或工作地点时，天气应用便会向用户自动弹出天气预报卡片。 在隐私方面，相应代码字符串显示 Personal Data Intelligence 会在用户设备本地分析位置数据，但用户的经纬度信息仍会分享给三星天气数据服务提供商 The Weather Channel，该服务商只会将位置数据用于提供天气信息，不会与第三方分享。 除了天气应用，三星还计划让 One UI 9.5 中的其他功能了解用户的日常通勤习惯。外媒 Android Authority 此前发现，三星为新版系统悄悄新增一项“三星驾驶报告（Driving Report）”功能，该功能能够在用户驾车出行前提前检查天气状况和睡眠评分，并在用户出发时间前约 1 小时推送相关提醒。 结合本次天气应用新增的通勤天气预测功能来看，三星似乎希望通过 One UI 9.5 更全面地学习用户的日常作息和出行规律，从而提供更加主动的个性化服务，预计这些功能将于明年年初 Galaxy S27 系列发布时在 One UI 9.5 正式版上线。
items.summary_en: Foreign outlet SammyGuru said that while examining Samsung's latest One UI 9.5 beta, it found Samsung is testing multiple AI smart reminder features for its weather app, with the system able to recognize users' wake-up times and commuting behavior and automatically load the latest weather information when users wake up, go to work or head home. The features rely on Samsung's Personal Data Intelligence system, which can identify when a user wakes up in the morning and when they start commuting; when the system detects the user leaving home or the workplace, the weather app automatically pops up a forecast card. On privacy, code strings indicate Personal Data Intelligence analyzes location data locally on the device, but the user's latitude and longitude are still shared with Samsung weather data provider The Weather Channel, which uses the location data only to provide weather information and does not share it with third parties. Beyond the weather app, Samsung also plans to let other One UI 9.5 features learn users' daily commuting habits. Android Authority previously found that Samsung quietly added a "Driving Report" feature to the new system, which can check weather conditions and sleep scores before a user drives and push a reminder about an hour before departure. Combined with the new commute-based weather prediction, Samsung appears to want One UI 9.5 to learn users' daily routines and travel patterns more comprehensively to offer more proactive personalized services; the features are expected to launch in the official One UI 9.5 with the Galaxy S27 series early next year.
items.why_zh: 推测：若落地，这类基于行为预测的主动提醒把个性化与隐私权衡推到前台，但当前仅为测试版代码线索，功能与上线时间未获官方确认。
items.why_en: Speculative: if shipped, such behavior-predicting proactive alerts would foreground the trade-off between personalization and privacy, but these are only beta code clues and neither the features nor the launch timing have been officially confirmed.

items.title_en: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
items.summary_zh: 这是“AI在现实生活”系列第三集、也是最后一集，主持人与The Verge资深AI记者Hayden Field讨论Anthropic的IPO。文中称，Claude背后的AI实验室上周四在纳斯达克上市；数字巨大，但对本次对话并不那么重要，只说明Anthropic已成为全球市值最高的公司之一。真正的问题在于接下来会发生什么，以及Anthropic能否在成为需对股东负责的上市公司的同时，继续兼顾并投资AI安全；此外它还要持续增长收入，以支付不断上升的算力账单——文中称未来几年合计约9000亿美元。Hayden与主持人试图分析，在Anthropic应对公开市场压力的过程中，这可能如何演变。节目还谈到该公司独特的公司治理结构（在“Jensen Huang”事件持续发酵的背景下尤显相关）、为何OpenAI似乎乐见Anthropic先上市，以及Anthropic面向大客户的整体卖点为何归结为同一套安全品牌——而这套品牌如今与其盈利导向的业务部分存在冲突。节目最后请听众订阅YouTube上的Decoder。
items.summary_en: Today, I’m talking with Hayden Field, The Verge ’s senior AI reporter, about the Anthropic IPO for the third and final episode in our series about AI in real life. The AI lab behind Claude went public on the Nasdaq last Thursday. The numbers are gigantic, but not really that important for this conversation, except to say that Anthropic has become one of the most valuable companies on the planet. The real story is what happens now — and whether Anthropic can continue to thread the needle of caring about and investing in AI safety while also being a public company beholden to shareholders. Oh, and it also continuously growing the amount of money it makes so it can keep paying its ever-increasing compute bills, which total roughly $900 billion over the coming years. All of these ideas sit in a fascinating tension with one another, and so Hayden and I really tried to break down how we think this might play out as Anthropic navigates the pressures of the public markets. You’ll hear us talk about the company’s unique corporate governance structure , something that is especially relevant in the wake of the ongoing Jensen Huang saga. We also get into why OpenAI seems happy to have let Anthropic go public first , and why Anthropic’s whole pitch to big customers boils down to the same safety branding that now sits in conflict with the profit-oriented part of its business. Before we get going, do me a favor and subscribe to Decoder on YouTube, where we put out new episodes every Monday and Thursday. items.source_summary: Today, I’m talking with Hayden Field, The Verge ’s senior AI reporter, about the Anthropic IPO for the third and final episode in our series about AI in real life. The AI lab behind Claude went public on the Nasdaq last Thursday. The numbers are gigantic, but not really that important for this conversation, except to say that Anthropic has become one of the most valuable companies on the planet. The real story is what happens now — and whether Anthropic can continue to thread the needle of caring about and investing in AI safety while also being a public company beholden to shareholders. Oh, and it also continuously growing the amount of money it makes so it can keep paying its ever-increasing compute bills, which total roughly $900 billion over the coming years. All of these ideas sit in a fascinating tension with one another, and so Hayden and I really tried to break down how we think this might play out as Anthropic navigates the pressures of the public markets. You’ll hear us talk about the company’s unique corporate governance structure , something that is especially relevant in the wake of the ongoing Jensen Huang saga. We also get into why OpenAI seems happy to have let Anthropic go public first , and why Anthropic’s whole pitch to big customers boils down to the same safety branding that now sits in conflict with the profit-oriented part of its business. items.title_en: South Korea's President Lee Jae-myung: speed is crucial in the AI race
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据路透社报道，当地时间 21 日，韩国总统李在明前往韩国东南部城市蔚山，视察当地一座在建数据中心，并敦促韩国加快在全球 AI 竞赛中的步伐。“ 全世界都在竞相角逐，速度至关重要 。” 数据中心是芯片需求的重要来源。李在明希望，SK 建设的蔚山项目能够取得成功，进而吸引全球 AI 企业加大投资。 蔚山数据中心由 SK 集团与亚马逊云科技共同开发。韩国科学技术信息通信部去年公布的估算显示，项目到 2029 年的总投资额预计为 7 万亿韩元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 351.26 亿元人民币） ，计划于 2027 年下半年投入运营。 SK 集团会长崔泰源 9 月介绍，在建数据中心首期容量 预计到 2029 年达到 103MW ，未来还计划在此基础上 扩容近 900MW 。随着项目推进，SK 也计划与全球科技公司建立更多合作。 李在明指出，AI 投资此前主要集中在首尔一带，蔚山项目则说明其他地区同样具备增长空间。得知现场约有 900 人参与施工后，他还提到，高端设施建设面临建筑工人短缺，各部委需要考虑如何培养建设数据中心和 AI 基础设施所需的工人。
items.summary_en: According to Reuters, on the 21st local time, South Korean President Lee Jae-myung visited a data center under construction in the southeastern city of Ulsan and urged South Korea to speed up in the global AI race. "The whole world is competing, and speed is crucial," he said. Data centers are a major source of chip demand. Lee hopes the SK-built Ulsan project will succeed and attract more investment from global AI companies. The Ulsan data center is being developed by SK Group and Amazon Web Services. Estimates published last year by South Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT put total investment in the project through 2029 at 7 trillion won, with operations planned to begin in the second half of 2027. SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won said in September that the first phase of the data center is expected to reach 103MW by 2029, with plans to add nearly 900MW on top of that. As the project advances, SK also plans more partnerships with global tech companies. Lee noted that AI investment had previously been concentrated around Seoul, and the Ulsan project shows other regions also have room to grow. After learning that about 900 people were working on the site, he also said high-end facility construction faces a shortage of construction workers and that ministries need to consider how to train the workers needed to build data centers and AI infrastructure.

items.title_en: Former Nvidia AI software product management director recalls Jensen Huang: tough, but warm underneath
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据《商业内幕》，现年 43 岁、曾与黄仁勋共事三年半的前英伟达 AI 应用软件产品管理总监贾马尔，讲述了自己近距离观察黄仁勋及与其共事的经历。 IT之家附上全文大意如下： 在英伟达，黄仁勋与员工保持密切接触 我 2022 年加入英伟达，一直工作到 2025 年下半年，担任 AI 应用软件产品管理总监，办公室位于总部的 Endeavor 大楼，与黄仁勋办公室共处一地。 入职第一天，我穿过公司主楼时，突然看见黄仁勋独自从走廊里走出来。我忍不住上前向他问好。他马上停下脚步，热情地回应了我，我们当场 聊了三四十秒 。 此前我在博通工作了四年，却从未有过这样偶遇 CEO 的经历。黄仁勋表现出的 亲和力和谦逊 让我印象深刻，那是一次很好的初次接触。 只要他没有出差，我基本每隔三四天就能在办公室走廊里见到他一次。他是否出差也很容易判断：如果他不在办公室，门外等着与他见面的人就不会那么多。 根据工作内容的不同，我每隔四到六周会参加一次与黄仁勋面对面的集体会议。我从未见过他单独与员工进行一对一会谈。他更倾向于让七人、十人甚至更多人一起开会，确保所有人在同一时间获得完全一致的信息。 “Top 5 Things” 邮件让公司信息保持透明 英伟达有一条不成文的规定：参加黄仁勋的会议之前，最好先把自己的“Top 5 Things”（T5T）邮件发出去。 T5T 是一种简单直接的工作汇报机制。每位员工每周或每月都要向黄仁勋及其管理团队发送邮件，列出自己负责的五项重点工作、目前遇到的障碍，以及需要哪些帮助。 黄仁勋不会依靠传统管理层级层层过滤信息，而是通过阅读数千封 T5T 邮件，直接、实时地了解公司的实际情况。无论你是初级工程师还是高级总监，都有机会让自己的声音和技术见解直达最高管理层。这也让整个组织保持信息透明，确保所有人目标一致、步调协调。 我经常看到黄仁勋亲自回复员工的 T5T 邮件。当然，并不是每封邮件都会得到回复，但员工都会发送邮件，并将他抄送在内。 我记得有一次会议上，有人提出一个问题，黄仁勋随即暂停会议，问道：“你在‘Top 5 Things’邮件里写过这个问题吗？”在场的人立刻纷纷低头查看自己的笔记本电脑。 这让我意识到，T5T 绝不是走形式的工作汇报。黄仁勋希望员工主动汇报手头的工作和遇到的问题，让能够解决问题的人参与进来。 通过 T5T，公司实现了自下而上的信息互通。 黄仁勋亲自把关每一个细节 筹备 GTC（英伟达旗舰 AI 大会）时，最能体现黄仁勋对工作的投入，以及他对自己所擅长领域的热爱。我们会专门开会，确定哪些演示项目能够在 GTC 上展示。 黄仁勋和团队对演示效果近乎苛求，力求每个环节都做到完美。他不满足于只看幻灯片，还会亲自走遍演示区，逐一检查每个展台，不断追问：“为什么要这样设计？这个东西具体在做什么？” 我记得有一次，他在一个演示展台前停留了将近 30 分钟，亲自给团队提出具体改进意见，指导他们如何进一步提升演示效果。团队按照他的建议修改后，再次展示时效果明显更好。 没有任何演示项目能够绕过他的技术标准。只有达到他个人对技术完美的要求，才有资格登上舞台。 我从黄仁勋身上学到的重要经验之一，是尽可能减少管理层与一线实际情况之间的信息隔阂。他能够直接与工程师和产品开发人员交流，不让中层管理者过滤、扭曲实际情况。看到他如此有效地做到这一点，我也学会了贴近产品本身的问题，以及客户在使用过程中遇到的实际障碍。 他也有温暖的一面 除了工作中表现出的强烈投入，黄仁勋还有鲜为外界所知的温暖和人情味，而这一面很少出现在新闻报道中。 2024 年初，我女儿出生后，给黄仁勋发了一封简短邮件报喜。我本以为他工作繁忙，未必有时间留意，没想到他在五分钟内就回复了我，向我表示祝贺。 几天后，也可能是一周后，我正在开会，他的行政助理突然走进会议室，当着所有人的面叫了我的名字。随后，她带我来到黄仁勋的办公室。那里有一个他特意为我刚出生的女儿准备的精美礼盒。 我和妻子打开礼盒，发现里面有一张黄仁勋留下的卡片，上面写着：“谢赫拉姆，恭喜你喜得千金。祝妈妈和宝宝一切安好。” 我想，那张卡片确实是他亲笔写的，也有他的签名。礼盒里还有印有英伟达标志、送给女儿的衣服和袜子。 我从没听过有人抱怨黄仁勋 过去一周，关于黄仁勋的新闻很多。但如果只…
items.summary_en: According to Business Insider, Jamal, 43, a former director of product management for AI application software at Nvidia who worked with Jensen Huang for three and a half years, described his close-up observations of Huang and what it was like to work with him. Jamal joined Nvidia in 2022 and worked there until the second half of 2025 as director of product management for AI application software, with an office in the headquarters' Endeavor building, in the same place as Huang's office. On his first day, while crossing the main building, he suddenly saw Huang walk out of the corridor alone, so he went up to say hello; Huang immediately stopped and responded warmly, and the two chatted for 30 to 40 seconds. He had previously worked at Broadcom for four years but had never run into the CEO like that, and Huang's approachability and humility left a strong impression. When Huang was not traveling, Jamal would usually see him in the office corridor every three or four days; it was also easy to tell whether Huang was traveling: if he was not in the office, there were fewer people waiting outside to meet him. Depending on the work, he attended an in-person group meeting with Huang every four to six weeks; he never saw Huang hold one-on-one meetings with employees, as Huang preferred meetings of seven, ten or more people to ensure everyone received exactly the same information at the same time. Nvidia had an unwritten rule: before attending a meeting with Huang, it was best to have sent your "Top 5 Things" (T5T) email. T5T is a simple, direct reporting mechanism: every week or month, each employee emails Huang and his management team listing the five most important things they are working on, current obstacles, and what help they need. Rather than relying on traditional management layers to filter information, Huang reads thousands of T5T emails to understand the company's actual situation directly and in real time; whether you are a junior engineer or a senior director, you have a chance to send your voice and technical views straight to the top. Jamal often saw Huang personally reply to employees' T5T emails; not every email got a reply, of course, but employees sent them and copied him. He recalled a meeting where someone raised a question and Huang paused the meeting to ask: "Did you write about this in your 'Top 5 Things' email?" Everyone present immediately looked down at their laptops. That made him realize T5T was not a formality; Huang wants employees to proactively report their work and problems so that the people who can solve them are involved. Through T5T, the company achieved bottom-up information flow. Preparing for GTC, Nvidia's flagship AI conference, best showed Huang's dedication and love for the area he excels in. They would hold dedicated meetings to decide which demos could be shown at GTC; Huang and the team were近乎 demanding about demo quality, seeking perfection in every detail. He was not satisfied with just looking at slides; he walked the demo area himself, checked every booth and kept asking: "Why is it designed this way? What exactly does this thing do?" Jamal recalled one time Huang stayed at a demo booth for nearly 30 minutes, personally giving the team specific suggestions for improvement and coaching them on how to make the demo better; after the team revised it as suggested, the second showing was noticeably better. No demo could bypass his technical standards; only those meeting his personal standard of technical perfection were allowed on stage. One of the key lessons Jamal took from Huang was to minimize the information gap between management and the front line; Huang could talk directly with engineers and product developers without letting middle managers filter or distort the real situation. Beyond his intense engagement at work, Huang also has a warmth and human touch little known to the outside world, a side rarely seen in news reports. In early 2024, after his daughter was born, Jamal sent Huang a short email sharing the news; he assumed Huang would be too busy to notice, but Huang replied within five minutes to congratulate him. A few days, maybe a week, later, Jamal was in a meeting when Huang's executive assistant suddenly walked in, called his name in front of everyone, and took him to Huang's office; there was a精美的 gift box Huang had prepared especially for Jamal's newborn daughter. He and his wife opened it and found a card from Huang that read: "Shehram, congratulations on your daughter. Best wishes to mother and baby." Jamal believes the card was indeed handwritten by Huang and bore his signature; the box also contained Nvidia-logo clothes and socks for his daughter. items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据《商业内幕》，现年 43 岁、曾与黄仁勋共事三年半的前英伟达 AI 应用软件产品管理总监贾马尔，讲述了自己近距离观察黄仁勋及与其共事的经历。 IT之家附上全文大意如下： 在英伟达，黄仁勋与员工保持密切接触 我 2022 年加入英伟达，一直工作到 2025 年下半年，担任 AI 应用软件产品管理总监，办公室位于总部的 Endeavor 大楼，与黄仁勋办公室共处一地。 入职第一天，我穿过公司主楼时，突然看见黄仁勋独自从走廊里走出来。我忍不住上前向他问好。他马上停下脚步，热情地回应了我，我们当场 聊了三四十秒 。 此前我在博通工作了四年，却从未有过这样偶遇 CEO 的经历。黄仁勋表现出的 亲和力和谦逊 让我印象深刻，那是一次很好的初次接触。 只要他没有出差，我基本每隔三四天就能在办公室走廊里见到他一次。他是否出差也很容易判断：如果他不在办公室，门外等着与他见面的人就不会那么多。 根据工作内容的不同，我每隔四到六周会参加一次与黄仁勋面对面的集体会议。我从未见过他单独与员工进行一对一会谈。他更倾向于让七人、十人甚至更多人一起开会，确保所有人在同一时间获得完全一致的信息。 “Top 5 Things” 邮件让公司信息保持透明 英伟达有一条不成文的规定：参加黄仁勋的会议之前，最好先把自己的“Top 5 Things”（T5T）邮件发出去。 T5T 是一种简单直接的工作汇报机制。每位员工每周或每月都要向黄仁勋及其管理团队发送邮件，列出自己负责的五项重点工作、目前遇到的障碍，以及需要哪些帮助。 黄仁勋不会依靠传统管理层级层层过滤信息，而是通过阅读数千封 T5T 邮件，直接、实时地了解公司的实际情况。无论你是初级工程师还是高级总监，都有机会让自己的声音和技术见解直达最高管理层。这也让整个组织保持信息透明，确保所有人目标一致、步调协调。 我经常看到黄仁勋亲自回复员工的 T5T 邮件。当然，并不是每封邮件都会得到回复，但员工都会发送邮件，并将他抄送在内。 我记得有一次会议上，有人提出一个问题，黄仁勋随即暂停会议，问道：“你在‘Top 5 Things’邮件里写过这个问题吗？”在场的人立刻纷纷低头查看自己的笔记本电脑。 这让我意识到，T5T 绝不是走形式的工作汇报。黄仁勋希望员工主动汇报手头的工作和遇到的问题，让能够解决问题的人参与进来。 通过 T5T，公司实现了自下而上的信息互通。 黄仁勋亲自把关每一个细节 筹备 GTC（英伟达旗舰 AI 大会）时，最能体现黄仁勋对工作的投入，以及他对自己所擅长领域的热爱。我们会专门开会，确定哪些演示项目能够在 GTC 上展示。 黄仁勋和团队对演示效果近乎苛求，力求每个环节都做到完美。他不满足于只看幻灯片，还会亲自走遍演示区，逐一检查每个展台，不断追问：“为什么要这样设计？这个东西具体在做什么？” 我记得有一次，他在一个演示展台前停留了将近 30 分钟，亲自给团队提出具体改进意见，指导他们如何进一步提升演示效果。团队按照他的建议修改后，再次展示时效果明显更好。 没有任何演示项目能够绕过他的技术标准。只有达到他个人对技术完美的要求，才有资格登上舞台。 我从黄仁勋身上学到的重要经验之一，是尽可能减少管理层与一线实际情况之间的信息隔阂。他能够直接与工程师和产品开发人员交流，不让中层管理者过滤、扭曲实际情况。看到他如此有效地做到这一点，我也学会了贴近产品本身的问题，以及客户在使用过程中遇到的实际障碍。 他也有温暖的一面 除了工作中表现出的强烈投入，黄仁勋还有鲜为外界所知的温暖和人情味，而这一面很少出现在新闻报道中。 2024 年初，我女儿出生后，给黄仁勋发了一封简短邮件报喜。我本以为他工作繁忙，未必有时间留意，没想到他在五分钟内就回复了我，向我表示祝贺。 几天后，也可能是一周后，我正在开会，他的行政助理突然走进会议室，当着所有人的面叫了我的名字。随后，她带我来到黄仁勋的办公室。那里有一个他特意为我刚出生的女儿准备的精美礼盒。 我和妻子打开礼盒，发现里面有一张黄仁勋留下的卡片，上面写着：“谢赫拉姆，恭喜你喜得千金。祝妈妈和宝宝一切安好。” 我想，那张卡片确实是他亲笔写的，也有他的签名。礼盒里还有印有英伟达标志、送给女儿的衣服和袜子。 我从没听过有人抱怨黄仁勋 过去一周，关于黄仁勋的新闻很多。但如果只…

items.title_zh: 谷歌为 Gemini 上线 GIF 动态图片生成功能，由 Omni 1.2 Flash 模型驱动
items.title_en: Google adds GIF generation to Gemini, powered by the Omni 1.2 Flash model
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，谷歌宣布为 Gemini 上线 GIF 生成功能，相应功能由视频模型 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 驱动，可生成循环动态图效和搞笑表情包。 该功能面向所有 Google AI 订阅用户开放，并在美国、日本、韩国、澳大利亚、加拿大、英国、德国和法国免费。用户可在主聊天输入提示词，或在图像与视频工具中选择 GIF 并描述需求，等待片刻即可生成图片。 IT之家注意到，谷歌还于 11 月 18 日推出了 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Neon，主攻复杂编程、科学研究和企业工作流程，更好平衡推理能力、任务处理速度与成本，目前已开始向开发者、企业及部分付费订阅用户开放。 费用方面，Gemini 4 Neon 在 API 调用方面，每 100 万词元输入费用为 3 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20 元人民币） ，每 100 万词元输出费用为 15 美元 （现汇率约合 100.2 元人民币） ，缓存输入每百万 token 为 0.15 美元 （现汇率约合 1 元人民币） ，并提供 Low、medium、high 以及 xhigh 四种推理级别。用户订阅 Google AI Pro 或 Ultra 后可以在 Gemini 应用中选择使用该模型。
items.summary_en: Google announced that GIF generation is now available in Gemini, powered by its video model Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, which can produce looping animated effects and humorous meme images. The feature is available to all Google AI subscribers and is free in the US, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Canada, the UK, Germany and France. Users can enter a prompt in the main chat, or select GIF in the image and video tools and describe what they want, then wait briefly for the image to be generated. IT之家 also noted that on November 18 Google launched the AI model Gemini 4 Neon, aimed at complex coding, scientific research and enterprise workflows and seeking a better balance of reasoning capability, task throughput and cost; it is now rolling out to developers, enterprises and some paid subscribers. On pricing, Gemini 4 Neon costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens via API, with cached input at $0.15 per million tokens, and offers four reasoning levels: Low, medium, high and xhigh. Subscribers to Google AI Pro or Ultra can select the model in the Gemini app.
items.why_zh: 推测：把视频生成能力压缩成轻量、易传播的 GIF，并多国免费开放，可能是为了扩大 Google AI 订阅用户在社交内容场景中的日常使用。
items.why_en: Speculative: packaging video generation into lightweight, shareable GIFs and offering it free in several countries may be aimed at driving everyday use of Google AI subscriptions in social content scenarios.

items.title_zh: 华中科技大学与阿里巴巴联合成立 AI 前沿安全研究中心，课题覆盖大模型安全攻防等
items.title_en: HUST and Alibaba launch joint AI frontier security research center with nine initial projects
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，华中科技大学与阿里巴巴集团于 11 月 18 日签署合作协议，聚焦 AI 安全共建“智能攻防与前沿安全联合研究中心”，首批启动 9 个课题。 IT之家获悉，联合研究中心首批启动的 9 个课题，覆盖 大模型安全攻防、智能体与终端安全、智能化系统与软件安全、数据协同与隐私保护 四大方向，以下为官方公开的案例： 当 AI 智能体开始替用户操作手机、完成复杂任务时，屏幕画面可能被伪造，操作过程也可能受到恶意诱导。对此，联合研究中心设立“图像对抗样本与终端威胁研判”课题，探索相关安全风险的识别与防护技术。 当用户在购物、地图、外卖等应用之间切换时，既希望享受数据互通带来的便捷，又担心个人信息在协同过程中泄露。针对这一问题，“隐私保护关系图谱”课题将探索通过密态计算等技术，实现数据“可用不可见、协同不透传”，让便利与隐私保护不再成为单选题。
items.summary_en: Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Alibaba Group signed a cooperation agreement on November 18 to jointly build the “Intelligent Attack-Defense and Frontier Security Joint Research Center” focused on AI security, with nine projects launched in the first batch. The nine projects cover four areas: large-model security attack and defense, agent and endpoint security, security of intelligent systems and software, and data collaboration and privacy protection. Among the publicly disclosed examples: because screen images may be forged and operations may be maliciously induced when AI agents act on a user's phone to complete complex tasks, a project on “image adversarial samples and endpoint threat assessment” will explore identification and protection technologies for such risks; and because users switching among shopping, maps and food-delivery apps want data interoperability without leaking personal information, a “privacy-preserving relationship graph” project will explore technologies such as encrypted computation to achieve data that is “usable but not visible, collaborative but not passed through.”
items.why_zh: 推测：校企联手把大模型与智能体安全纳入产业落地环节，显示 AI 安全研究正从模型层扩展到终端、智能体与隐私协同场景。
items.why_en: Speculative: the university-industry partnership embeds large-model and agent security in real deployments, suggesting AI security research is expanding from the model layer to endpoint, agent and privacy-collaboration scenarios.

items.title_en: Nothing's first AI-native hardware set for December 8: screenless, likely focused on meeting notes
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，Nothing 发文，预热旗下首款 AI 原生硬件设备将于 12 月 8 日正式亮相。这款产品将采用无屏幕设计，定位为面向日常办公与生产力场景的 AI 工具。 从 此前公布的预热图片 来看，这款设备采用小巧的矩形机身，表面使用拉丝金属材质，并配有实体按键。其中一个面积较大的按键标有“Talk”字样，另一个按键则带有录音标识，机身上还提供红色与绿色 LED 状态指示灯，可以看出该产品预计主打会议记录用途。 Nothing 首席执行官裴宇此前曾表示，当前 AI 技术面临的一大问题是缺乏对用户日常生活的理解。尽管大模型已经具备较强的处理能力，但用户在会议、交谈等场景中产生的信息，往往无法及时成为 AI 能够使用的上下文。因此，Nothing 希望通过专门的硬件设备，让 AI 更自然地融入日常工作。此外，裴宇还透露“相应产品没有屏幕，也不是一款软件应用”。
items.summary_en: Nothing teased that its first AI-native hardware device will be officially unveiled on December 8. The product uses a screenless design and is positioned as an AI tool for everyday office and productivity scenarios. Based on previously released teaser images, the device has a small rectangular body with a brushed metal surface and physical buttons: one larger button is labeled “Talk,” another carries a recording icon, and the body has red and green LED status lights, suggesting the product is likely aimed at meeting-notes use. Nothing CEO Carl Pei previously said a major problem with today's AI is its lack of understanding of users' daily lives; although large models are already capable, information generated in meetings, conversations and similar settings often cannot promptly become context the AI can use, so Nothing hopes dedicated hardware can bring AI more naturally into daily work. He also said the product “has no screen and is not a software app.”
items.why_zh: 推测：无屏幕、带实体按键的专用设备代表“让 AI 获取日常上下文”的另一条硬件路径，与手机和应用内助手路线形成对照。
items.why_en: Speculative: a screenless, button-equipped dedicated device represents an alternative hardware route to giving AI everyday context, contrasting with phone- and app-based assistant approaches.

items.title_en: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
items.summary_zh: 在美国总统特朗普与中国国家主席习近平、俄罗斯总统普京举行峰会后于周五举行的记者会上，特朗普表示“我们不会允许我们的公司在我国之外建设数据中心”，并称将对在境外建设数据中心的企业征收“巨额税收”。他说，芯片和其他领域此前“被允许这样做，这对我们的国家极具破坏性，我们就是从那时开始落后的”。报道同时提到，美国各州和城市正在对新建数据中心的申请施加限制。报道摘录在此处中断，特朗普未说明该税收的具体方案。

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，韩媒 Economy Tribune 今天（21 日）下午爆料称，三星电子 2027 年至 2029 年的大部分存储芯片产能 都已被合同预订 。随着 AI 数据中心投资持续扩大，存储芯片供应短缺长期难以缓解，部分客户开始要求签订长期供货协议（LTA）， 希望将供货保障期限延长至 2031 年 。 供应紧张的局面不仅出现在高带宽内存（HBM）领域，通用 DRAM 和企业级 NAND 闪存同样面临短缺。主要存储芯片制造商的议价能力预计将因此进一步增强。 据知情人士 21 日透露，三星电子 2027 年至 2029 年的大部分存储芯片产能 都已被合同锁定 。 客户不再满足于现有合同约定的供货量，纷纷要求增加供应。部分客户还在推动将合同期限 延长至 2031 年 。 三星电子上月 29 日公布第三季度业绩时曾透露，公司已与 10 家主要客户签订 LTA，另有 10 家客户仍在谈判中。三星计划到 2030 年，通过 LTA 锁定 60% 至 70% 的存储芯片产能 。 业内消息称，三星电子与客户也在考虑签订包含预付款、价格上下限条款的长期合同。三星此前在业绩发布会上透露，目前签订的 LTA 均设有价格下限条款。 长期供货协议不断增加的同时，存储芯片市场的供需缺口也在扩大。 业内数据显示，主要存储芯片制造商目前的 供货满足率只有 60% 至 70% ，预计 2027 年供应短缺还将进一步加剧。 其中，2027 年通用 DRAM 的晶圆产能实际上已全部售罄。DRAM 比特供给增幅预计每年最高也只有 20% 至 25%。 HBM 产能扩张也进一步挤压了通用 DRAM 的供应空间。据IT之家了解，由于生产 HBM 需要占用比普通 DRAM 更多的晶圆产能 ，HBM 在整体生产中的占比越高， 通用 DRAM 扩大供应的空间就越有限 。 NAND 闪存市场同样面临供应紧张，企业级产品的短缺尤为突出。一名业内人士指出，目前市场对 NAND 闪存的咨询量很大。与现货市场不同，合约市场的需求反而在增长。消费级 NAND 的供货满足率近期大幅提升至 70%，但企业级 SSD 的供货满足率仍超过 50%。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 21: South Korean outlet Economy Tribune reported that most of Samsung Electronics' memory chip capacity from 2027 to 2029 has already been booked under contracts. As AI data center investment keeps expanding and the memory shortage is expected to persist, some customers are seeking long-term agreements (LTAs) and asking for supply guarantees through 2031. Tightness is not limited to high-bandwidth memory (HBM); general-purpose DRAM and enterprise NAND flash are also in short supply, and major memory makers' bargaining power is expected to strengthen further. People familiar with the matter said customers are no longer satisfied with contracted volumes and are asking for more supply, with some pushing to extend contracts to 2031. When Samsung reported third-quarter results on Oct 29, it said it had signed LTAs with 10 major customers and was still negotiating with 10 others, and aims to lock up 60% to 70% of its memory capacity through LTAs by 2030. Industry sources said the two sides are also considering long-term contracts with prepayments and price floor/ceiling clauses; Samsung has said its current LTAs include price floor terms. Industry data show major memory makers' order fill rates are only 60% to 70%, with the shortage expected to worsen in 2027; general DRAM wafer capacity for 2027 is effectively sold out, and DRAM bit supply growth is projected at only 20% to 25% a year at most. HBM expansion further squeezes general DRAM supply: HBM consumes more wafer capacity than ordinary DRAM, so the higher HBM's share of output, the less room there is to expand general DRAM supply. NAND flash is also tight, especially enterprise products. One industry source said there is a lot of NAND inquiry and, unlike the spot market, contract market demand is growing; consumer NAND fill rates recently rose sharply to 70%, while enterprise SSD fill rates remain above 50%.
items.why_zh: 推测：若产能锁定与长期协议属实，存储厂商议价能力将进一步增强，并可能推高 AI 数据中心与终端厂商的采购成本与交付不确定性。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the capacity lock-ups and long-term agreements hold, memory makers' pricing power would grow further, potentially raising procurement costs and delivery uncertainty for AI data center and device makers.

items.title_zh: 微软回应 To Do 待办应用明年停服，承诺帮用户“平稳过渡”
items.title_en: Microsoft responds to To Do app shutdown next year, promises to help users 'transition smoothly'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，科技媒体 NeoWin 今天（11 月 21 日）刊发来自微软 AI 和智能体产品总监霍华德 · 克劳（Howard Crow）， 回应旗下任务管理应用 Microsoft To Do 停运事件 。 IT之家曾于 11 月 19 日报道，微软官网发布公告，Microsoft To Do 将于 2027 年 6 月 30 日停用，包括网页版、Windows、Mac、iOS 和安卓客户端。 在接替方案上，微软推荐企业和教育用户迁移到 Microsoft Planner；但对于个人微软账户、Microsoft 365 个人版和家庭版订阅者的用户，则需要自行选择新的待办事项工具。 在最新声明中，微软表示将会提供更多支持和指导，帮助 Microsoft To Do 现有用户迁移，相关声明内容如下： 我们将打通 Microsoft 365 全平台的任务管理能力，助力用户高效处理个人待办与团队计划。 伴随本次架构整合，Microsoft To Do 应用将于 2027 年 6 月 30 日下线，工作与学业场景下的任务功能统一迁移至 Microsoft Planner。此外 Outlook、Teams 等 Microsoft 365 生态内现有集成通道，也将同步改造适配 Planner。 我们深知这项调整对不同用户的影响各不相同，尤其涉及个人微软账号使用者，我们会全力协助大家做好迁移准备。下线前，用户可导出全部 To Do 数据；我们后续也会发布详尽指引，支撑本次平稳过渡。 由于微软没有提供直接的迁移途径，其他第三方任务管理服务迅速抓住机会，其中 Todoist 已上线专门的 Microsoft To Do 导入器：用户登录或注册 Todoist、授权只读访问 Microsoft 账户后，可选择待办清单并一键导入，完成后还会收到邮件通知。 另一款竞品名为 Superlist，由 Wunderlist 创始人 Christian Reber 创立。它提供与 Microsoft To Do 的双向同步功能，可同步清单名称、任务名称、截止日期和完成状态，让用户能在 To Do 关闭前逐步过渡。 相关阅读： 《 微软宣布砍掉 To Do 待办应用，建议用户迁移到 Microsoft Planner 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 21 that tech outlet NeoWin published a response that day from Howard Crow, Microsoft's director of AI and agent products, regarding the shutdown of Microsoft To Do. IT之家 had reported on Nov 19 that a Microsoft website notice said Microsoft To Do will be discontinued on June 30, 2027, including the web version and Windows, Mac, iOS and Android clients. For replacements, Microsoft recommends that enterprise and education users migrate to Microsoft Planner; users of personal Microsoft accounts and Microsoft 365 Personal/Family subscriptions must choose a new to-do tool themselves. In the latest statement, Microsoft said it will provide more support and guidance to help existing To Do users migrate, and said it will connect task management capabilities across Microsoft 365; after To Do goes offline, task features for work and school scenarios will migrate uniformly to Planner, and existing integration channels such as Outlook and Teams will be adapted for Planner. Before the shutdown, users can export all their To Do data, and detailed guidance will be published later. Because Microsoft has not provided a direct migration path, third-party services moved quickly: Todoist launched a dedicated Microsoft To Do importer, and Superlist, founded by Wunderlist creator Christian Reber, offers two-way sync for list names, task names, due dates and completion status.
items.why_zh: 微软未给个人用户提供直接迁移路径，第三方待办应用正借机承接用户；实际影响仍待观察（推测）。
items.why_en: Microsoft has not offered individual users a direct migration path, and third-party to-do apps are moving to capture them; the actual impact remains to be seen (speculation).

items.title_en: NIO announces NWM 3.0 world model to launch at NIO IN 2026 NIO Innovation Technology Day on November 25
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，蔚来今日宣布，在即将于 11 月 25 日举办的 NIO IN 2026 蔚来创新科技日上， 将正式发布 NWM 3.0 世界模型 。 官方表示，NWM 3.0 将会在 模型架构、闭环训练、跨域融合 等方面，带来蔚来智能辅助驾驶团队对物理世界人工智能的最新思考与探索成果，敬请期待。 据IT之家此前报道，2024 年 7 月， 蔚来发布行业首个智能辅助驾驶世界模型 ——「蔚来世界模型 NWM」（NIO World Model）。 据介绍，蔚来世界模型是一个多元自回归生成模型，可全量理解数据、长时序推演和决策， 具备像人一样「空间认知-想象重建」和「时间认知-想象推演」的能力 ，并且可以输出规划轨迹。 相比常规的端到端架构，蔚来世界模型在空间理解上，通过生成式模型重构传感器输入，更加泛化地抽取信息；在时间理解上，通过自回归模型，自动建模长时序环境；在海量数据使用上，通过自监督学习的方式，无需人工标注。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 21 that NIO announced today that at the upcoming NIO IN 2026 NIO Innovation Technology Day on November 25, it will officially release the NWM 3.0 world model. The company said NWM 3.0 will bring the NIO assisted-driving team's latest thoughts and exploration results on physical-world AI in areas such as model architecture, closed-loop training, and cross-domain fusion. IT之家 previously reported that in July 2024 NIO released the industry's first assisted-driving world model, the 'NIO World Model' (NWM). According to the introduction, the NIO World Model is a multi-variate autoregressive generative model that can fully understand data, perform long-horizon reasoning and decision-making, has human-like abilities of 'spatial cognition-imaginative reconstruction' and 'temporal cognition-imaginative reasoning,' and can output planned trajectories. Compared with conventional end-to-end architectures, the NIO World Model, in spatial understanding, reconstructs sensor inputs through a generative model to extract information more generally; in temporal understanding, it automatically models long-horizon environments through an autoregressive model; and in using massive data, it uses self-supervised learning without manual annotation.
items.why_zh: 推测：世界模型是智能辅助驾驶竞争的关键方向，NWM 3.0 的发布可能影响蔚来在物理世界 AI 上的技术叙事，但实际能力需看发布细节。
items.why_en: Speculation: world models are a key direction in assisted-driving competition, so NWM 3.0 could affect NIO's physical-world AI narrative, though real capabilities depend on release details.

items.title_zh: 亚马逊硬刚纽约拟议《配送保护法》：喊话消费者当心配送费涨价最高 5 美元
items.title_en: Amazon pushes back against New York's proposed Delivery Protection Act, warns customers of delivery fees rising by up to $5
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，当地时间 20 日，据《华尔街日报》报道，亚马逊对纽约市的一项劳工法案《配送保护法》（又称第 518 号提案）发起了反击。该法案将强制 企业直接雇佣送货人员 ，而不是外包给第三方承包商。 不仅如此，亚马逊通过弹出窗口警告客户：如果该法案最终成为法律，每笔订单的配送费用或将 涨价 5 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 33.5 元人民币） 。 该法案将改变亚马逊配送司机的实际雇主身份。按照目前的配送模式，在身穿亚马逊马甲、驾驶亚马逊货车，甚至受到亚马逊 AI 摄像头的驾驶行为监控的司机背后，实际的雇主往往是 亚马逊旗下配送体系中的小型合作企业 ，或称配送服务合作伙伴（Delivery Service Partners）。 根据纽约市这项法案，亚马逊若想继续在纽约市五大行政区运营配送站，就必须将定期从这些站点配送包裹的司机 纳入自己的员工工资名册。 即使是兼职司机，只要在任意 30 天内累计从事配送工作超过 8 小时，也在适用范围内。此外，配送站内负责包裹分拣的员工同样受到这项规定约束。 对于已经从事配送工作的司机，法案也设置了就业保障条款。如果亚马逊为遵守法律而终止配送合同，导致合作企业裁掉司机，亚马逊就必须 优先向这些司机提供原来的岗位，以亚马逊员工身份重新聘用他们 ，之后才能招募其他人接手。新岗位的聘用条件，也不得低于司机原先的工作条件。 纽约市市长佐赫兰 · 马姆达尼支持这项法案。他指出，亚马逊通过分包模式，将配送业务交给合作企业，从而逃避了对一线配送人员承担的责任。亚马逊则反驳称，法案将 危及其在纽约市合作的 40 多家配送企业 ，以及这些企业 5000 多名员工的生计。 亚马逊更表态，不排除将配送站迁出纽约市。倘若如此，纽约市民可能 面临更高的费用 ，包裹配送时间也可能延长。 亚马逊还将这套说辞搬到了自己的应用程序和网站上，与黑色星期五促销优惠一同展示。页面上的“立即行动”按钮会引导购物者进入一段预先拟好的信息，要求所在选区的市议员投票反对该法案。 纽约市议会议长朱莉 · 梅宁也对亚马逊作出了回应。她说：“如果亚马逊认为，靠这场误导性宣传就能威胁纽约市民、恐吓市议会，那就大错特错了！”
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 21: On the 20th local time, The Wall Street Journal reported that Amazon has pushed back against a New York City labor bill, the Delivery Protection Act (also known as Introduction 518). The bill would require companies to directly employ delivery workers rather than outsource to third-party contractors. Amazon also warned customers through pop-up windows that if the bill becomes law, delivery fees per order could rise by $5 (about RMB 33.5 at current exchange rates, per IT Home). The bill would change the actual employer identity of Amazon delivery drivers. Under the current delivery model, behind drivers wearing Amazon vests, driving Amazon vans and even monitored by Amazon AI cameras for driving behavior, the actual employers are often small partner companies in Amazon's delivery system, or Delivery Service Partners. Under the New York City bill, if Amazon wants to continue operating delivery stations in the five boroughs, it must put drivers who regularly deliver packages from those stations onto its own payroll. Even part-time drivers who accumulate more than 8 hours of delivery work in any 30 days would be covered. In addition, employees responsible for package sorting at delivery stations would also be subject to the rule. For drivers already doing delivery work, the bill also sets employment protection provisions. If Amazon terminates delivery contracts to comply with the law, causing partner companies to lay off drivers, Amazon must first offer those drivers their original positions and rehire them as Amazon employees before recruiting others to take over. The hiring conditions for the new positions must not be lower than the drivers' original working conditions. New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani supports the bill. He said Amazon uses the subcontracting model to hand delivery operations to partner companies, thereby evading responsibility for frontline delivery workers. Amazon counters that the bill would endanger more than 40 delivery companies it works with in New York City and the livelihoods of more than 5,000 employees at those companies. Amazon further stated it does not rule out moving delivery stations out of New York City. If so, New Yorkers could face higher fees and longer package delivery times. Amazon also put this argument on its app and website, displayed alongside Black Friday promotions. A 'Take Action' button leads shoppers to a pre-written message asking their district's city council member to vote against the bill. New York City Council Speaker Julie Menin also responded to Amazon. She said: 'If Amazon thinks it can threaten New Yorkers and intimidate the City Council with this misleading campaign, it is badly mistaken!'

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，当地时间 20 日，据《华尔街日报》报道，亚马逊对纽约市的一项劳工法案《配送保护法》（又称第 518 号提案）发起了反击。该法案将强制 企业直接雇佣送货人员 ，而不是外包给第三方承包商。 不仅如此，亚马逊通过弹出窗口警告客户：如果该法案最终成为法律，每笔订单的配送费用或将 涨价 5 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 33.5 元人民币） 。 该法案将改变亚马逊配送司机的实际雇主身份。按照目前的配送模式，在身穿亚马逊马甲、驾驶亚马逊货车，甚至受到亚马逊 AI 摄像头的驾驶行为监控的司机背后，实际的雇主往往是 亚马逊旗下配送体系中的小型合作企业 ，或称配送服务合作伙伴（Delivery Service Partners）。 根据纽约市这项法案，亚马逊若想继续在纽约市五大行政区运营配送站，就必须将定期从这些站点配送包裹的司机 纳入自己的员工工资名册。 即使是兼职司机，只要在任意 30 天内累计从事配送工作超过 8 小时，也在适用范围内。此外，配送站内负责包裹分拣的员工同样受到这项规定约束。 对于已经从事配送工作的司机，法案也设置了就业保障条款。如果亚马逊为遵守法律而终止配送合同，导致合作企业裁掉司机，亚马逊就必须 优先向这些司机提供原来的岗位，以亚马逊员工身份重新聘用他们 ，之后才能招募其他人接手。新岗位的聘用条件，也不得低于司机原先的工作条件。 纽约市市长佐赫兰 · 马姆达尼支持这项法案。他指出，亚马逊通过分包模式，将配送业务交给合作企业，从而逃避了对一线配送人员承担的责任。亚马逊则反驳称，法案将 危及其在纽约市合作的 40 多家配送企业 ，以及这些企业 5000 多名员工的生计。 亚马逊更表态，不排除将配送站迁出纽约市。倘若如此，纽约市民可能 面临更高的费用 ，包裹配送时间也可能延长。 亚马逊还将这套说辞搬到了自己的应用程序和网站上，与黑色星期五促销优惠一同展示。页面上的“立即行动”按钮会引导购物者进入一段预先拟好的信息，要求所在选区的市议员投票反对该法案。 纽约市议会议长朱莉 · 梅宁也对亚马逊作出了回应。她说：“如果亚马逊认为，靠这场误导性宣传就能威胁纽约市民、恐吓市议会，那就大错特错了！”

items.title_zh: 欧洲央行行长拉加德：欧盟应利用公共资金，率先承担大型芯片厂、数据中心等项目首轮损失
items.title_en: ECB President Lagarde: EU should use public funds to take first losses on large chip plant and data center projects
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据美国 CNBC 报道，当地时间 11 月 20 日，欧洲央行行长克里斯蒂娜 · 拉加德在法兰克福欧洲银行业大会发表卸任前最后一次演讲时呼吁， 欧盟应利用公共资金，在大型芯片制造厂和数据中心项目中率先承担首轮损失，以此吸引私人资本 。 她指出：“如果某项挑战需要欧洲层面的解决方案，我们就应该加强有能力提供这种方案的欧洲机构。在技术领域，芯片制造厂和数据中心项目需要 在整个欧洲范围内达到一定规模 。因此，欧洲应建立跨区域的公私合作伙伴关系，由公共资金，包括欧盟预算资金，先行承担项目的首轮损失，吸引私人资本参与。” 拉加德此前曾警告，欧洲现有的数据中心容量无法满足自身需求，欧盟计划在境内建设一个最多由七座超级工厂组成的网络，但这一计划仍然不够。 拉加德提出这一主张之际，人工智能热潮带动的基础设施及配套项目正面临越来越多的争议，项目本身也愈发复杂、成本高昂。从欧洲、亚洲到美国，都出现了这一趋势。 她援引的一项近期估算显示，如果到 2030 年将欧洲在全球 AI 算力中的占比从约 5% 提高到 15%，所需投资将达到约 1.3 万亿欧元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 9.54 万亿元人民币） 。 拉加德在法兰克福向听众发表讲话时直言：“我们能够及早发现问题，却往往要等到问题变得无法忽视时才能采取行动。而到了那一步，几乎注定为时已晚。失去的产业很难重新夺回，一旦我们的依赖关系被人利用来对付我们，欧洲的主权便已暴露在风险之中。”
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 21: According to US CNBC, on Nov 20 local time, European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde, in her final speech before stepping down at the Frankfurt European Banking Congress, called on the EU to use public funds to take first losses in large chip manufacturing plant and data center projects, thereby attracting private capital. She said: 'If a challenge requires a European-level solution, we should strengthen the European institutions capable of providing such a solution. In technology, chip plants and data center projects need to reach a certain scale across Europe. Therefore, Europe should establish cross-regional public-private partnerships, with public funds, including EU budget funds, first absorbing the first round of losses to attract private capital.' Lagarde had previously warned that Europe's existing data center capacity cannot meet its needs, and that the EU's plan to build a network of up to seven gigafactories within its territory is still insufficient. Lagarde's proposal comes as AI-driven infrastructure and supporting projects face growing controversy and are becoming more complex and costly. This trend is appearing from Europe and Asia to the US. She cited a recent estimate that raising Europe's share of global AI computing power from about 5% to 15% by 2030 would require about €1.3 trillion (about RMB 9.54 trillion at current exchange rates, per IT Home). Speaking to the audience in Frankfurt, Lagarde said bluntly: 'We can identify problems early, but often can only act when they become impossible to ignore. By then, it is almost certainly too late. Lost industries are hard to win back, and once our dependencies are exploited against us, Europe's sovereignty is already exposed to risk.'

items.title_zh: 美国公司将特斯拉 Model 3 爆改成 MPV，超充、OTA、辅助驾驶都能用
items.title_en: US company converts Tesla Model 3 into an MPV, retaining Supercharging, OTA and driver assistance
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据《商业内幕》今天（21 日）晚间报道，特斯拉从未涉足 MPV 市场，杰弗里 · 霍夫曼看中了这一市场空白，希望抓住商机。不过，他并不打算从零开始创办汽车公司。 他创立的 Hoffman EV 是一家总部位于美国威斯康星州、成立六年的企业，近日在拉斯维加斯的 SEMA 展会上展示了 Badger。霍夫曼将其形容为一款 “外观有些傻气”的电动汽车 ，融合了越野玩具、厢型车和特斯拉零部件再利用项目的特点。“我想打造一款有趣的产品，做出来的东西就是我自己想用的。” 美国电动汽车的普及速度远不及底特律车企当初的设想，车企因此计提了数十亿美元资产减记，市场上也留下了一大批停产或取消的电动汽车车型。 霍夫曼推出 Badger 之际，美国企业正尝试更多电动汽车产品，希望找到消费者愿意买单的方向。这些新尝试与此前那些体型庞大、价格高昂，却始终难以打动美国消费者的电动卡车大不相同。 Badger 选择了不同的技术路线。Hoffman EV 没有自行研发汽车平台，而是直接 拆取旧款特斯拉 Model 3 的电池、电机、车载电脑、摄像头、车内屏幕、线束和座椅 ，再为车辆配上全新的铝制车身。 目前，Badger 不仅可以使用特斯拉超级充电网络，还能获得特斯拉的软件更新，并调用其半自动驾驶技术。不过，这些权限能否继续保留，取决于是否会叫停。 霍夫曼认为，这种依赖特斯拉的风险值得承担。驾驶 Badger，他既能用上美国汽车业的一些顶尖技术，也不必选择那些体型庞大、价格昂贵、难以获得美国消费者认可的电动卡车。“我不明白为什么一定要造那么大、那么大的皮卡，以至于驾驶员坐在车里连引擎盖前方都看不见。这款车的设计绝不是为了满足虚荣心或彰显大男子主义。” 为了参加 SEMA 展会，霍夫曼亲自驾驶 Badger 往返拉斯维加斯。不过，该车目前的高速续航里程 只有约 240km ，他坦言，这样的表现恐怕难以接受。 Hoffman EV 希望下一辆原型车的高速续航里程达到 320km，目前正着手优化空气动力学设计，力求降低风噪、延长续航里程。 Badger 对特斯拉的依赖程度相当高 ，但双方实际上没有任何沟通。霍夫曼坦言，特斯拉未来可以限制 Badger 接入其服务，甚至禁用其他功能。 虽然 Badger 在技术上支持特斯拉 FSD（监督版）半自动驾驶功能 ，霍夫曼却不建议使用。他提醒称，由于 Badger 的车身长度短于 Model 3，车身尺寸差异可能会让这套技术难以适应。 Hoffman EV 将 2027 年定为开放预订和启动生产的目标年份，预计年产量约 100 辆。 目前给出的目标价格分别为：底盘约 1 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 66,920 元人民币） 、车身套件约 4 万美元 （现汇率约合 26.8 万元人民币） ，组装费用约 1 万美元 （现汇率约合 66,920 元人民币） 。 如果再算上一辆价值约 2 万美元 （现汇率约合 13.4 万元人民币） 、用于提供零部件的 Model 3，Badger 的税前总价或为约 7 万美元 （现汇率约合 46.8 万元人民币） 。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 21: Business Insider reported on the evening of the 21st that Tesla has never entered the MPV market, and Jeffrey Hoffman saw this market gap and wanted to seize the business opportunity. However, he did not plan to start a car company from scratch. His company Hoffman EV, a six-year-old firm headquartered in Wisconsin, recently showcased the Badger at the SEMA show in Las Vegas. Hoffman describes it as a 'somewhat silly-looking' electric vehicle that blends an off-road toy, a van and a Tesla parts-reuse project. 'I wanted to build a fun product, something I myself would use.' The adoption of electric vehicles in the US has been far slower than Detroit automakers initially envisioned, leading automakers to take billions of dollars in asset write-downs and leaving the market with a large number of discontinued or canceled EV models. Hoffman launched the Badger as US companies try more EV products, hoping to find a direction consumers are willing to pay for. These new attempts are very different from the previous large, expensive electric trucks that struggled to win over US consumers. The Badger takes a different technical route. Hoffman EV did not develop its own vehicle platform, but directly removed the battery, motor, onboard computer, cameras, in-car screen, wiring harness and seats from older Tesla Model 3s, then fitted the vehicle with a new aluminum body. At present, the Badger can not only use Tesla's Supercharger network, but also receive Tesla software updates and invoke its semi-autonomous driving technology. However, whether these permissions can be retained depends on whether they are stopped. Hoffman believes the risk of relying on Tesla is worth taking. Driving the Badger, he can use some of the top technology in the US auto industry without having to choose those large, expensive electric trucks that are hard for US consumers to accept. 'I don't understand why one must build such large, such large pickups that the driver cannot even see in front of the hood from inside. This car's design is definitely not meant to satisfy vanity or show machismo.' To attend the SEMA show, Hoffman personally drove the Badger to and from Las Vegas. However, the car's current highway range is only about 240 km, and he admits such performance is probably unacceptable. Hoffman EV hopes the next prototype will reach a highway range of 320 km, and is currently working to optimize aerodynamic design to reduce wind noise and extend range. The Badger's dependence on Tesla is quite high, but the two sides actually have no communication. Hoffman admits that Tesla could in the future restrict the Badger's access to its services or even disable other functions. Although the Badger technically supports Tesla FSD (Supervised) semi-autonomous driving, Hoffman does not recommend using it. He warned that because the Badger's body length is shorter than the Model 3, the size difference could make the technology difficult to adapt. Hoffman EV has set 2027 as the target year for opening reservations and starting production, with estimated annual output of about 100 vehicles. The current target prices are: chassis about $10,000 (about RMB 66,920 at current exchange rates, per IT Home), body kit about $40,000 (about RMB 268,000), assembly fee about $10,000 (about RMB 66,920). If one also counts a Model 3 worth about $20,000 (about RMB 134,000) used to provide parts, the Badger's total pre-tax price may be about $70,000 (about RMB 468,000).

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据《商业内幕》今天（21 日）晚间报道，特斯拉从未涉足 MPV 市场，杰弗里 · 霍夫曼看中了这一市场空白，希望抓住商机。不过，他并不打算从零开始创办汽车公司。 他创立的 Hoffman EV 是一家总部位于美国威斯康星州、成立六年的企业，近日在拉斯维加斯的 SEMA 展会上展示了 Badger。霍夫曼将其形容为一款 “外观有些傻气”的电动汽车 ，融合了越野玩具、厢型车和特斯拉零部件再利用项目的特点。“我想打造一款有趣的产品，做出来的东西就是我自己想用的。” 美国电动汽车的普及速度远不及底特律车企当初的设想，车企因此计提了数十亿美元资产减记，市场上也留下了一大批停产或取消的电动汽车车型。 霍夫曼推出 Badger 之际，美国企业正尝试更多电动汽车产品，希望找到消费者愿意买单的方向。这些新尝试与此前那些体型庞大、价格高昂，却始终难以打动美国消费者的电动卡车大不相同。 Badger 选择了不同的技术路线。Hoffman EV 没有自行研发汽车平台，而是直接 拆取旧款特斯拉 Model 3 的电池、电机、车载电脑、摄像头、车内屏幕、线束和座椅 ，再为车辆配上全新的铝制车身。 目前，Badger 不仅可以使用特斯拉超级充电网络，还能获得特斯拉的软件更新，并调用其半自动驾驶技术。不过，这些权限能否继续保留，取决于是否会叫停。 霍夫曼认为，这种依赖特斯拉的风险值得承担。驾驶 Badger，他既能用上美国汽车业的一些顶尖技术，也不必选择那些体型庞大、价格昂贵、难以获得美国消费者认可的电动卡车。“我不明白为什么一定要造那么大、那么大的皮卡，以至于驾驶员坐在车里连引擎盖前方都看不见。这款车的设计绝不是为了满足虚荣心或彰显大男子主义。” 为了参加 SEMA 展会，霍夫曼亲自驾驶 Badger 往返拉斯维加斯。不过，该车目前的高速续航里程 只有约 240km ，他坦言，这样的表现恐怕难以接受。 Hoffman EV 希望下一辆原型车的高速续航里程达到 320km，目前正着手优化空气动力学设计，力求降低风噪、延长续航里程。 Badger 对特斯拉的依赖程度相当高 ，但双方实际上没有任何沟通。霍夫曼坦言，特斯拉未来可以限制 Badger 接入其服务，甚至禁用其他功能。 虽然 Badger 在技术上支持特斯拉 FSD（监督版）半自动驾驶功能 ，霍夫曼却不建议使用。他提醒称，由于 Badger 的车身长度短于 Model 3，车身尺寸差异可能会让这套技术难以适应。 Hoffman EV 将 2027 年定为开放预订和启动生产的目标年份，预计年产量约 100 辆。 目前给出的目标价格分别为：底盘约 1 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 66,920 元人民币） 、车身套件约 4 万美元 （现汇率约合 26.8 万元人民币） ，组装费用约 1 万美元 （现汇率约合 66,920 元人民币） 。 如果再算上一辆价值约 2 万美元 （现汇率约合 13.4 万元人民币） 、用于提供零部件的 Model 3，Badger 的税前总价或为约 7 万美元 （现汇率约合 46.8 万元人民币） 。

items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 21: Yu Chengdong posted that HIMA's Stelato V8 has officially begun nationwide large-scale deliveries. The car was officially launched yesterday, comprising seven models with a price range of RMB 319,800–429,800; locked-in orders exceeded 2,216 units within 2 hours of launch. According to previous IT Home reports, the Stelato V8 has dimensions of 5335/2005/1805 mm and a wheelbase of 3250 mm, with a 2+2+3 seven-seat layout; except for the Max+, other versions can choose 800V range-extender or 800V pure electric power. Stelato V8 Ultra+ EREV from RMB 399,800 | BEV from RMB 429,800: four-wheel drive + dual-chamber air springs + dual-valve continuously variable damping dampers; four lidars | L3 autonomous driving architecture design | second-row rotating zero-gravity seats. Stelato V8 Ultra EREV from RMB 359,800 | BEV from RMB 389,800: 21.4-inch Huawei cloud clear matte ceiling screen; four lidars | L3 autonomous driving architecture design. Stelato V8 Max+ EREV from RMB 349,800: four-wheel drive + dual-chamber air springs + dual-valve continuously variable damping dampers; common optical path in-cabin lidar | 21.4-inch Huawei cloud clear matte ceiling screen. Stelato V8 Max EREV from RMB 319,800 | BEV from RMB 349,800: EREV standard 56 kWh battery | BEV standard 120 kWh battery; common optical path in-cabin lidar | all series standard ±12° rear-wheel steering.

items.title_zh: 不只是华为，消息称其他厂商也考虑为旗舰产品线引入阔直板形态
items.title_en: Not just Huawei: other vendors reportedly consider adding wide-slab form factor to flagship lines
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，博主 @数码闲聊站 今天（21 日）下午爆料称，当下手机市场“阔形态”升级势不可挡：除了华为，其他家也考虑在正代旗舰线加入阔形态， 与常规直板机双线并行 。 @数码闲聊站 在回复网友评论时还透露，安卓阵营中，阔直板与常规直板双线并行，且 常规直板机定位高于阔直板 ；“真小屏手机”今后将会越来越少。 综合IT之家此前报道，本月早些时候的消息称，华为 Pura X View 阔直板手机上市 66 天， 激活销量已突破 100 万台 。 此外，预计属于 OPPO 的阔折 也已经蓄势待发 ，搭载 2nm 骁龙 AI 旗舰芯，采用宽屏无感折痕设计，后置 2 亿云台影像； 阔直板手机加速推进中 ，搭载天玑 9 旗舰芯，配备 16:9 窄边框定制屏，后置 2 亿大底影像。 同样在本月上旬，安卓阵营首款阔直板手机 酷派 COOL X Wide 正式开售 ，售价区间 999-1399 元，搭载联发科曦力 G99 芯片，配备 6.38 英寸 720p 90Hz 屏幕，后置 5000 万像素主摄，提供鎏白、岩黑、嫣红三色可选。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 21: Blogger @Digital Chat Station tipped this afternoon (the 21st) that the 'wide form factor' upgrade in the current phone market is unstoppable: besides Huawei, other companies are also considering adding a wide form factor to their main flagship lines, running in parallel with regular slab phones. In replies to netizens, @Digital Chat Station also revealed that in the Android camp, wide slabs and regular slabs will run in parallel, and regular slab phones are positioned higher than wide slabs; 'true small-screen phones' will become fewer in the future. According to previous IT Home reports, news earlier this month said Huawei's Pura X View wide-slab phone, 66 days after launch, had surpassed 1 million activated sales. In addition, a wide foldable expected to belong to OPPO is also ready to launch, equipped with a 2nm Snapdragon AI flagship chip, a wide-screen crease-less design, and a rear 200MP gimbal camera; a wide-slab phone is accelerating, equipped with a Dimensity 9 flagship chip, a custom 16:9 narrow-bezel screen, and a rear 200MP large-sensor camera. Also in early this month, the Android camp's first wide-slab phone, Coolpad COOL X Wide, officially went on sale, priced RMB 999–1,399, equipped with a MediaTek Helio G99 chip, a 6.38-inch 720p 90Hz screen, a rear 50MP main camera, and available in three colors: gilded white, rock black and crimson.
items.why_zh: 这显示手机形态可能在华为带动下出现新分支，但消息来自爆料者，尚未获厂商确认（推测）。
items.why_en: It suggests phone form factors may be branching out after Huawei's move, but the report comes from a tipster and has not been confirmed by vendors (speculative).

items.summary_en: Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information . CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm "in time for the holidays in December," but he didn't provide a price at the time. When he announced the Muse Charm, Zuckerberg said that the company had "packed the whole Muse experience," including real-time voice and avatar technology, into the gadget. It has a fingerprint sensor, and you can tap it to be able to talk to a Muse AI agent without unlocking a phone or opening an app. … Read the full story at The Verge.

items.why_en: If the price is accurate, it could mark a step by Meta to extend its AI agent from phone apps to standalone hardware; however, the price comes from a secondary report and has not been confirmed by Meta (speculation).
